code: set.seed(2026L) g <- rep(c("g1", "g2", "g3"), each = 40L) mu <- c(g1 = 0, g2 = 2, g3 = 4)[g] d <- data.frame(x = mu + stats::rnorm(120L), g = factor(g)) d$y <- -1.5 * mu + 0.8 * (d$x - mu) + stats::rnorm(120L, sd = 0.4) d$z <- sin(d$x) + stats::rnorm(120L, sd = 0.3) vars <- c("x", "y", "z") fit_a <- janusplot_fit(d, vars, engine = "gam", derivatives = integer()) fit_b <- janusplot_fit(d, vars, adjust = ~ g, engine = "gam",                        derivatives = integer()) cmp <- janusplot_compare(fit_a, fit_b,                          labels = c("marginal", "group-adjusted")) cmp #> janusplot comparison: marginal against group-adjusted #> 3 variables (x, y, z), 3 pairs, 6 directed cells #> adjust: marginal = none, group-adjusted = ~g #> From marginal to group-adjusted, the shape changed in 4 of 6 directed cells (3 of 3 pairs), the archetype in 3 and the trend in 3. #> Cells whose shape changed: #>   x ~ s(y): shape rippled_wave -> convex_up, EDF 7.14 -> 1.91, A 0.22 -> 0.14 #>   x ~ s(z): shape linear_down -> s_shape, EDF 1.00 -> 1.00, A 0.78 -> 0.78 #>   y ~ s(x): shape wave -> s_shape, EDF 4.54 -> 2.51, A 0.22 -> 0.14 #>   y ~ s(z): shape linear_up -> linear_down, EDF 1.00 -> 1.00, A 0.78 -> 0.77 cmp$table[, c("var_x", "var_y", "edf_a", "edf_b", "shape_changed")] #>   var_x var_y    edf_a    edf_b shape_changed #> 1     y     x 7.143071 1.908503          TRUE #> 2     z     x 1.000060 1.000900          TRUE #> 3     x     y 4.538976 2.507604          TRUE #> 4     z     y 1.000176 1.000168          TRUE #> 5     x     z 7.994207 7.969067         FALSE #> 6     y     z 8.077788 7.643365         FALSE
